name: progress
useFor: Use Progress for a known amount: usage against a plan, a clone or an upload. Put ProgressLabel and ProgressValue inside it to show what it measures. Use variant="accent" only near a limit. value={null} shows work with no known end.
constraints: The orange for a normal amount
source: The Hoplite website's plan usage meter (.pa-usage, .pa-usage__bar), drawn square on the quiet line
title: Progress
description: A square usage bar: a 2px quiet track with the ink filling it to the value, or the orange when a limit is close; a 14px medium label and a Kode Mono value can sit above it.
